avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra/Ma Huang
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive sympathomimetic effects; increased risk of tachycardia, hypertension, arrhythmias, and tremor
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated - do not use concurrently with albuterol

avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Alpha-2 antagonist with sympathomimetic properties; potentiates cardiovascular stimulation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; consider alternative supplements with patient approval

avoid_supplements.name: Caffeine supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive stimulant effects on central nervous and cardiovascular systems; increased tremor and anxiety
avoid_supplements.action: Limit caffeine intake; advise patient to restrict to <200mg daily

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild sympathomimetic effects may modestly enhance albuterol's cardiovascular stimulation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased tremor or palpitations; use lowest effective dose

caution_supplements.name: Licorice root
caution_supplements.mechanism: May increase sodium retention and hypertension risk when combined with sympathomimetics
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; limit duration of use to <4-6 weeks

caution_foods.name: High-caffeine beverages (coffee, energy drinks, cola)
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive stimulant effects may increase nervousness, tremor, and palpitations
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; counsel patient to monitor tolerance and reduce if adverse effects occur

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May potentiate fluid retention and hypertension in susceptible individuals using beta-2 agonists
caution_foods.action: Encourage dietary sodium moderation, particularly in patients with hypertension or cardiac conditions

monitoring_notes: Monitor for increased tremor, palpitations, anxiety, and cardiovascular effects when albuterol is combined with sympathomimetic supplements or high caffeine intake. Counsel patients on avoidance of stimulant supplements and moderation of caffeine-containing foods and beverages.
